channel.title: Hashbeam
channel.description: Hashbeam reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network security, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and market structure across blockchains and tokens.

item.title: Injective Veyra vote clears quorum as Nov. 24 upgrade nears
item.description: Injective’s Veyra upgrade proposal has passed the stated turnout quorum in an active vote, setting a conditional block-height halt for v1.21.0 on November 24.

item.title: US authorizes seizure or restraint of $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department says court-authorized seizure or restraint now covers more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, while tracing and forfeiture efforts continue.

item.title: DOJ targets $1.2 billion in Binance theft proceeds
item.description: The Justice Department says court authorization covers more than $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds, within $2.7 billion frozen as laundering continues.

item.title: Pyth adds NYSE BQT market data to its marketplace
item.description: Pyth now distributes NYSE BQT through its marketplace, giving licensed applications live quotes, trades and market-status data across five NYSE Group exchanges.

item.title: Coinbase’s OCC trust charter takes effect after April approval
item.description: Coinbase National Trust Company became effective November 6, moving its custody business into an OCC framework while remaining a non-insured trust bank.

item.title: PNC opens Coinbase-powered USDC payments pilot
item.description: PNC’s eligible corporate clients can receive USDC on Ethereum through a Coinbase-powered pilot; payments convert 1:1 to dollars and land in designated PNC accounts.

item.title: Fake interview opened path to Binance’s $6.34bn theft
item.description: Binance says a fake recruitment process compromised an engineer's device before attackers used the wallet signing service to move $6.34bn in digital assets.

item.title: FinCEN orders U.S. institutions to block transfers involving MEXC
item.description: FinCEN has ordered U.S. institutions to block transfers involving MEXC, citing $16.7 billion in alleged illicit flows and a Russian finance finding.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7 with 25-second block target
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, moving its proof-of-work target from 75 to 25 seconds while resizing rewards and changing fee and shielded-transaction rules.

item.title: Zcash activates NU7 with 25-second block target
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, targeting 25-second blocks while capping shielded activity and redirecting fees to future mining rewards.

item.title: Bitcoin developer sketches quantum landmines with BTC collateral
item.description: Cory Fields sketched a Bitcoin thought experiment that locks matching collateral during vulnerable-coin spends, giving prepared owners time to claim it after a quantum attack.

item.title: Which RenBridge hashes show a transfer completed?
item.description: A deposit hash, RenVM hash and destination hash mark different stages; only the successful destination-chain transaction proves the asset arrived there.

item.title: Matcha swap: how routing turns a token trade into a transaction
item.description: A Matcha swap searches available liquidity, builds an executable route, then asks your wallet to authorize and submit an onchain transaction that can still fail.

item.title: Stellar’s Bell upgrade clears testnet, mainnet vote set for Nov. 23
item.description: Stellar’s Bell Protocol 30 upgrade is live on testnet, adding muxed contract addresses and contract-level ML-DSA checks before validators vote on mainnet Nov. 23.

item.title: Kim Yo Jong denies North Korean role in Binance theft
item.description: Kim Yo Jong rejected the FBI’s attribution of Binance’s $6.34 billion theft to North Korea, while Binance’s account describes unauthorized use of its wallet signing service.

item.title: Binance details EIP-7702 role in $6.34B theft
item.description: Binance says attackers used internal signing access and Ethereum’s EIP-7702 delegation to move $6.34 billion; it reports 98% of affected assets replenished.

item.title: New Jersey Rescinds Coinbase Staking Order
item.description: New Jersey withdrew its 2023 order against Coinbase on Oct. 30, removing the state restriction on new staking while leaving future enforcement possible.

item.title: OKX urges real-time alerts after $6.3 billion Binance hack
item.description: After Binance’s $6.3 billion breach, Coinbase adjusted offline key systems and OKX’s Star Xu urged exchanges to share alerts and coordinate freezes.

item.title: Binance Users Pull $4.72B After Hack, Exchange Reopens
item.description: Binance customers withdrew a net $4.72 billion after withdrawals resumed, following a $6.3 billion hot-wallet breach that froze access for about 48 hours.

item.title: Binance reports $3bn frozen after $6.3bn hot-wallet breach
item.description: Binance says partners have frozen about $3 billion after an incident drained roughly $6.3 billion from its hot wallets, while investigators trace the funds.
